title_zh: 可退出的AI城市 / CLEAN EXIT CITY
principle: AI must not only switch off; every sidecar must carry a spatial return state for the ordinary city.
off_on_rule: AI OFF is a complete city; AI ON is the same city plus lateral reversible capability. Ordinary route geometry does not change.

contracts.ai_off: work, meal/rest, green spine and public exchange remain continuous
contracts.ai_on_delta: stoppable test, temporary equipment and replaceable service interfaces attach at side yards/service edges
contracts.remove_test: remove the sidecar without relocating ROAD-009
evidence_required: professional safety review for any real test interface
contracts.reality_boundary: No lane width, speed, emergency-stop timing, bollard design or permit is claimed.
contracts.ordinary_restore_use: ordinary campus courtyard, work/rest edge and public exchange

contracts.ai_off: home, human help, shared learning and civic commons remain account-free
contracts.ai_on_delta: opt-in navigation, service matching and care prompts attach to public-ground-floor/community interfaces
contracts.remove_test: remove the sidecar without login requirements or relocating ROAD-010
contracts.reality_boundary: No service radius, accessibility dimension, staffing level or response-time performance is claimed.
contracts.ordinary_restore_use: account-free public ground floor, staffed human help and civic commons

contracts.ai_off: fixed wayfinding, staffed help, ordinary waiting/retail and the Jing-Zhang public interface remain usable
contracts.ai_on_delta: dynamic translation, information and crowd assistance attach laterally
contracts.remove_test: switch off dynamic information without relocating ROAD-011
evidence_required: verified station entrances and real level data
passenger-flow, ownership and operating evidence before engineering design
contracts.reality_boundary: PROV-KEY-003 has known absolute-location risk; no station entrance, bridge/tunnel, level, corridor width or throughput is claimed.
contracts.ordinary_restore_use: fixed wayfinding, staffed help and ordinary waiting/retail; real station levels remain required
